verdict.rationale: Secureframe embeds task-specific AI features under the 'Comply AI' brand. These include automated risk assessments with scores and justifications, generative policy writing and AI text revisions, extraction of answers from vendor documents, auto-generated IaC remediation fixes, and AI-generated SSPs/POA&Ms. Users can hand off discrete compliance tasks this way, but the evidence never describes a general built-in assistant or agent that takes arbitrary delegated tasks. The MCP server exposes data to external agents and is not an in-product assistant. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant or agent interface (chat or task delegation across modules), multi-step agentic execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features.
